newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ex-Germany average rates fell 0.2pct in July - CASS.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Germany average rates fell 0.2pct in July - CASS.

text.p: The slump in average yields in the German air cargo market slowed to a 0.2 percent fall in July, International Air Transport Air Cargo Association (IATA) statistics showed.

Airlines exported a total of 46,541 tonnes from Germany in July, a 5.4 percent increase on 12 months previously, according to monthly figures from the IATA Cargo Accounts Settlement System (CASS) supplied to Reuters.
But total revenue rose just 0.6 percent, indicating that pressure on rates per kg continued in July.
Strong year-on-year tonnage and revenue growth was shown in July by South-East Asia, the Far East and Latin America, while South Asia and Africa declined,
In comparison, June showed an average rate per kg fall of 1.7 percent after total tonnage rose 1.4 percent but revenue fell 2.9 percent. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
